adjustment.header:
# Pinned snapshot of the shared core for the released FHP line (the payload
# below is byte-identical to schemas/core.yaml at FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification
# v0.5.0 release commit 170e677fbb6726a3f765373dbe1f214820000be7, at the v0.6.0
# release commit 0ae18b00ee4bd71ab2dc28bae706b0f9d195076b, and at shared
# origin/main, verified by scripts/check_shared_parity.py against provenance.json).
#
# FHP imports this snapshot because the released FHP 1.1 and 1.2 lines build on
# the v0.5 core: the x- extension-field rules (docs/FORMAT.md R15), the
# MAJOR.MINOR string schemaVersion patterns and the optional author nameType;
# the FHP 1.2 dotted BUSCO dataset versions (#170) live in schemas/shared.yaml,
# not in the core. The inherited FHR and FHGFF3 generation in this development
# tree still imports schemas/core.yaml (the v0.3-era core) and their published
# compatibility copies are unchanged; synchronizing them is the Q2 decision in
# docs/DEVELOPMENT-TREE-PROPOSAL.md.
# Do not edit: replace this file from a release, not by hand.
adjustment.reason: vendored snapshot with a provenance comment header, following schemas/core-v0.4.yaml (docs/DEVELOPMENT-TREE-PROPOSAL.md 2d)

adjustment.header:
# Pinned v0.6.0 snapshot of the shared FHP/FHGFF3 object model (the payload
# below is byte-identical to schemas/shared.yaml at FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification

# scripts/check_shared_parity.py against provenance.json).

# The FHP 1.2 model imports this snapshot: the dotted BUSCO dataset versions

# compatibility copy is generated from it (the Q2 decision in
# docs/DEVELOPMENT-TREE.md); advancing that chain is a shared-repository
# resync, not an FHP edit.
# Do not edit: replace this file from a release, not by hand.

no upstream revision recorded: bioheaders/fhp.context.jsonld is a byte copy of FHP-Specification jsonld/fhp.context.jsonld as of some unrecorded commit, so there is nothing to resolve it against. Recording a revision (or a tag, once FHP-Specification has one) is a maintainer act, not a gate act.

the toolkit vendors a filtered per-format copy of the shared manifest, not the upstream file, so no upstream file digest describes it. Equality with conformance/manifest.json at v0.6.0 is enforced fixture-file by fixture-file by tests/fhp_test.py::test_fixtures_match_the_specification, against the tag that .github/workflows/pytest.yaml checks out.

the toolkit holds no FHGM reference at all: it vendors no FHGM draft and pins no FHGFF3 base/carrier schema for one, so there is nothing here to compare with v0.5.0 or v0.6.0. Opening an FHGM lane is FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools#135; the base pin #241(b) is about lives in FHGM-Specification. The class is implemented and tested here (tests/pin_audit_test.py) so that lane has a gate to plug into, and this row keeps the missing axis visible instead of silently absent.

See owning table/provenance: the toolkit vendors all 26 examples/ files of specification tag v0.6.0 byte-identically (measured 2026-11-16: git ls-tree v0.6.0 -- examples vs this checkout, 26/26 digests equal) plus its own additions, and holds no copied-tree provenance record for them: the single-file released-contract rows pin the schemas and contexts, but no record names the examples tree, its upstream revision, or which toolkit example files are copies and which are toolkit-authored. Absence of a record is the finding (FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification#241 class copied-tree, FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools#163): this repository trips its own rule.
